name: Cucumber Edamame Salad
desc: High-protein cucumber and edamame tossed in a lemony Greek yogurt, dill and basil dressing with everything bagel seasoning.

source.evidence: Searched cucumber edamame salads with Greek yogurt, dill and everything bagel seasoning (Kalejunkie, Cooking For Peanuts, rachLmansfield); the published versions use soy or miso vinaigrettes and none match this yogurt-dressed version.

ingredients.raw: 1 cup shelled edamame, cooked and cooled
1 tsp everything bagel seasoning, plus more to taste
Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: If the edamame is frozen, cook it according to the package directions, then rinse under cold water and drain well.
Put the sliced cucumber and edamame in a bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk the yogurt, dill, basil, olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, and garlic powder. Taste and season with salt, pepper, or more lemon.
Pour the dressing over the cucumber and edamame, sprinkle with the everything bagel seasoning, and toss until coated.
tips: This is a lighter take on the pesto cucumber salad: olive oil, lemon zest, and garlic powder stand in for the richness, brightness, and garlic that pesto would bring.
